facts.fact: Cadmus Cyber Solutions states that, as at September 2024, the ODPC had fined at least nine businesses a total of KES 26,275,000 under the Data Protection Act and Regulations, including Oppo Kenya (2022, KES 5m) and SBM Bank (2024, KES 450,000).
Cadmus Cyber Solutions states the ODPC investigates complaints and has fined at least nine businesses between 2022 and September 2024.
